::: {#exr-miller-taylor-log-scaled}
#### Taylor series of $\log(1 + 2x)$

Adapted from @problifesavercalc, Question 1.1.30.

Find the first two non-zero terms of the Taylor series for

$$f(x) = \log(1 + 2x)$$

at $x_0 = 0$.
:::

::: {#sol-miller-taylor-log-scaled}
Substitute $u = 2x$ into the Maclaurin series $\log(1 + u) = u - \frac{u^2}{2} + \dots$:

$$\log(1 + 2x) = (2x) - \frac{(2x)^2}{2} + \dots = 2x - 2x^2 + \dots$$
:::
